# Experiment 47 tables (generated by scripts/summarize_label_budget.py)

Test split, normalized ranked probability score (RPS divided by K - 1; 0-1; lower is better). G(n) = test normalized RPS of the Pearson-trained head passed through a calibration map fitted on n validation labels, minus test normalized RPS of the CE-trained head used raw; positive = the CE-trained raw head is better. M(n) = the same Pearson-trained calibrated head minus the CE-trained head with a map fitted on the same n labels. Cells: mean over 5 split seeds x 20 calibration draws, then (SD over the 100 seed-draw cells). R1 = n items with one rating each (n labels); RA = n items with all their ratings. n is capped at the validation size.
